title: Life in a Day
notes: Artful, tense guitar pop with theatrical vocal edges; early experiments foreshadow stronger rhythmic abstraction.

title: Real to Real Cacophony
notes: Angular, exploratory post-punk; hypnotic bass, synthesizers and corridor ambience shape unsettled urban miniatures.

title: Empires and Dance
notes: Severe European travelogue: motorik bass grooves, synthetic pulses, brittle guitars and politically tense imagery.

title: Sons and Fascination
notes: Hillage steers dense, spacious post-punk toward insistent bass-led dance patterns and wider emotional reach.
